<script setup lang="ts">
import { type AlertDialogEmits, type AlertDialogProps, AlertDialogRoot, useForwardPropsEmits } from 'reka-ui';

    data-slot="alert-dialog"
    v-bind="forwarded"
  >
    <slot />
  </AlertDialogRoot>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { AlertDialogAction, type AlertDialogActionProps } from 'reka-ui';
import { useAttrs } from 'vue';
import { buttonVariants } from '@/components/ui/button';

const props = defineProps<AlertDialogActionProps>();
const attrs = useAttrs();
</script>

<template>
  <AlertDialogAction
    data-slot="alert-dialog-action"
    v-bind="props"
    class="sigma-ui-button"
    :class="[buttonVariants(), attrs.class]"
  >
    <slot />
  </AlertDialogAction>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { AlertDialogCancel, type AlertDialogCancelProps } from 'reka-ui';
import { useAttrs } from 'vue';
import { buttonVariants } from '@/components/ui/button';

const props = defineProps<AlertDialogCancelProps>();
const attrs = useAttrs();
</script>

<template>
  <AlertDialogCancel
    data-slot="alert-dialog-cancel"
    v-bind="props"
    class="sigma-ui-button sigma-ui-alert-dialog-cancel"
    :class="[buttonVariants({ variant: 'outline' }), attrs.class]"
  >
    <slot />
  </AlertDialogCancel>
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-alert-dialog-cancel {
  margin-top: 0.5rem;
}

@media (width >= 640px) {
  .sigma-ui-alert-dialog-cancel {
    margin-top: 0;
  }
}
</style>

<script setup lang="ts">
import {
  AlertDialogContent,
  type AlertDialogContentEmits,
  type AlertDialogContentProps,
  AlertDialogOverlay,
  AlertDialogPortal,
  useForwardPropsEmits,
} from 'reka-ui';
import { useAttrs } from 'vue';

const props = defineProps<AlertDialogContentProps>();
const emits = defineEmits<AlertDialogContentEmits>();
const attrs = useAttrs();

const forwarded = useForwardPropsEmits(props, emits);
</script>

<template>
  <AlertDialogPortal>
    <AlertDialogOverlay class="sigma-ui-alert-dialog-overlay" />
    <AlertDialogContent
      data-slot="alert-dialog-content"
      v-bind="forwarded"
      class="sigma-ui-alert-dialog-content"
      :class="attrs.class"
    >
      <slot />
    </AlertDialogContent>
  </AlertDialogPortal>
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-alert-dialog-overlay {
  position: fixed;
  z-index: 50;
  background-color: rgb(0 0 0 / 80%);
  inset: 0;
}

.sigma-ui-alert-dialog-overlay[data-state='open'] {
  animation: sigma-ui-fade-in 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
}

.sigma-ui-alert-dialog-overlay[data-state='closed'] {
  animation: sigma-ui-fade-out 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
}

.sigma-ui-alert-dialog-content {
  position: fixed;
  z-index: 50;
  top: 50%;
  left: 50%;
  display: grid;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 32rem;
  padding: 1.5rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  background-color: var(--background);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
  gap: 1rem;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  transition-duration: 200ms;
}

@media (width >= 640px) {
  .sigma-ui-alert-dialog-content {
    border-radius: var(--radius);
  }
}

.sigma-ui-alert-dialog-content[data-state='open'] {
  animation: sigma-ui-alert-dialog-show 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
}

.sigma-ui-alert-dialog-content[data-state='closed'] {
  animation: sigma-ui-alert-dialog-hide 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
}

@keyframes sigma-ui-alert-dialog-show {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(0.95);
  }

  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1);
  }
}

@keyframes sigma-ui-alert-dialog-hide {
  from {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1);
  }

  to {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(0.95);
  }
}
</style>
